text.text_excerpt: New Orleans isn't exactly overflowing with vegan options, so it's nice to have The Wandering Buddha maintain a semi-permanent position in the kitchen of the Hi-Ho Lounge. This is a Korean vegan restaurant, so everything on the menu is made without meat or dairy products. Dairy isn't that big a deal because there isn't much of it in Korean cuisine, but meat is a big deal because most Korean dishes, even the ostensibly vegetarian dishes, contain some amount of fermented seafood. The Wandering Buddha does a great job of making kimchi and other classics without the fish sauce element, and that element is not missed for the most part. Many of the entrees contain some form of tofu. The food is ...

We were looking for a decent vegetarian restaurant in New Orleans, and ended up finding much more. Note that a couple of people said that they wish the Wandering Buddha would expand to have indoor seating - you can eat indoors at the Ho Hi bar right on St Claude. The outdoor seating is actually down the street, but easily identified by the green christmas lights on the kitchen window. A sign will be up shortly. We had the Gimbap to start with, which was delicious. The Korean dipping sauce was out of this world. They had run out of the Yachae Mandu, but I'm sure that is delicious too (hence all those greedy people who ordered MY order! :p) For entrees we shared three - - Gungjunp Tteokbokk...

The Wandering Buddha is definitely high on my list of places to eat. The food is excellent and they were one of the first restaurants to pioneer the vegan movement in New Orleans. Staff is always friendly and quick to offer suggestions. Prices aren't dirt cheap but healthy organic and vegan ingredients cost more than inexpensive food filled with preservatives. The highest priced entree is $12. If you're seeking good grub and that "real Bywater experience" look no further this is it - The Wandering Buddha is tucked away behind the Hi Ho Lounge on historic St. Claude Avenue. Even if you're not a vegan or vegetarian I guarantee you'll love this place. Don't be fooled by the cliché statement ...
